description: Controlled maintenance activities are not scheduled, performed, documented, or reviewed for information systems.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of maintenance schedules, lack of maintenance records, no approval process for maintenance activities, and missing documentation of maintenance performed on system components.
